notes:
New
- Calendar invitations. Add workspace members or any email address as guests. Nothing is sent
  until you press Send update, and closing an event whose time, place or repeat changed asks once
  whether to send. Members answer Going, Maybe or Can't go from the invitation, with an optional
  note. Outside guests get the invitation by email, and for now their replies reach you by email
  only, without updating the event. On a connected iCloud or Fastmail calendar, invitations and
  your answers go from that account's address.
- Find a time shows when invited members are busy, never what their events are, for up to 20
  people over 8 days.
- Broadcast posts show real thumbnails of their images and videos, and Broadcast fits smaller
  windows.

Improved
- Broadcast uploads show their progress as a bar.

Fixed
- Answering an invitation that changed at the same moment now says it changed, instead of
  failing.
- Broadcast's notice about a disconnected channel now reads correctly in every case, and only
  tells you to reconnect if you can.
